title: Cohomology commutes with finite products of complexes of abelian groups
statement: Let $I$ be a finite set and, for each $i\in I$, let $K_i^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of abelian groups [def-sp-abelian]. The componentwise product complex $K^\bullet=\prod_{i\in I}K_i^\bullet$ has canonical natural isomorphisms $\mathcal H^q(K^\bullet)\cong\prod_{i\in I}\mathcal H^q(K_i^\bullet)$ for every integer $q$.
